faq.q: What are the platform character limits?
faq.a: Instagram captions allow 2,200 characters; X/Twitter posts allow 280; YouTube descriptions allow 5,000. This tool shows your live position against all three.
Any group of characters separated by spaces or newlines. Punctuation attached to a word is included in the character count but not counted separately.
Yes, the character count includes spaces, matching how most platform character limits are enforced.
No. All counting happens in your browser instantly.
